messages.subject: Executive Profile | ESG, External Affairs & Country Leadership | MENA
messages.body:
Dear Simon,

I am introducing my profile for senior mandates across the Middle East and North Africa. I currently serve as Liaison Director at AGM Inc., part of Zijin Mining Group, with leadership across government and regulatory relations, ESG, social responsibility, corporate affairs, stakeholder strategy, compliance coordination and executive communications.

I bring more than 12 years across multinational mining, regulated banking and commercial operations. I am internationally mobile and available on 30 days' notice.

My executive CV is attached for consideration for suitable Director, Head, Country, External Affairs, Government Relations, ESG, Sustainability, Strategic Partnerships or Chief of Staff mandates.

Best regards,
Ragunauth Ramsaroop
